releaseAIntent: Install and durably verify the overlap-safe deploy entrypoint without changing backend runtime files or activating its dormant PostgreSQL runtime assets.
releaseADormantAssetRule: Release A checks in the runtime library, Compose overlay, daily runner, systemd unit and topology verifier only as bootstrap prerequisites; backend.sha, postgres-runtime-current, installed units, the installed daily runner and running runtimes remain untouched until Release B.
releaseBIntent: Install the bounded Prisma pool and exact runtime topology only after Release A is proven on the host.
dailyTimerRule: This release installs pool topology and a guarded launcher but never creates or enables a daily timer.
